Thanks for visiting our website and/or downloading our e-book about out-of-area real estate investing from Biggerpockets.com.
Now, were you just looking for education when you came across our company, or are you serious about becoming a serious investor and building a passive income portfolio and start building real wealth that will impact your future?
Aside from publishing free content for newbie investors from time to time, our company, Memphis Invest, is the largest and the most respected turnkey company in the country, currently managing 5000+ properties across Memphis, Dallas/Ft.Worth, Houston, Little Rock, and Oklahoma City.
You can see 16 short videos right here where our owners discuss their investment strategies and how we assist investors to achieve long term wealth.
Attached you will find materials that will allow you to familiarize yourself with our company, our markets, the typical ROI you can expect from our offerings, property management metrics and performance data, and also answers to some of the most frequently asked questions.
If you are serious about beginning to build your real estate portfolio, your next step is to click right here to schedule a call with me I'll be happy to help you figure out if we are a good fit for you as a company, and if you are a good fit for us as a client.
Talk to you soon.
Marq
